queries.sql: SELECT m.nama_brg, COUNT(pd.id) AS total_transaksi, SUM(pd.jumlah) AS total_dipinjam FROM peminjaman_detail pd JOIN inventaris i ON i.id = pd.inventaris_id JOIN master_barang m ON m.kode_brg = i.id_master_barang GROUP BY m.nama_brg ORDER BY total_dipinjam DESC LIMIT 10
